<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Current state: corners + center are GREEN, cross cells are GRAY
# Try clicking cross cells one at a time
cross_cells = [(50, 30), (55, 25), (55, 35), (60, 30)]

def get_hud():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    hud = {}
    for n in seg:
        b = n['boundary']
        if b:
            rmin = min(p[0] for p in b)
            if 16 <= rmin <= 24 and n['pixels'] <= 100:
                cmin = min(p[1] for p in b)
                hud[(n['color'], cmin)] = n['pixels']
    return hud

def get_grid():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    grid = {}
    for n in seg:
        b = n['boundary']
        if b:
            rmin = min(p[0] for p in b)
            cmin = min(p[1] for p in b)
            if 47 <= rmin <= 63 and 22 <= cmin <= 38 and n['pixels'] <= 20:
                grid[(rmin, cmin)] = n['color']
    return grid

print(f"Initial: HUD={get_hud()}")
print(f"Initial grid: {get_grid()}")

# Click cross cells one at a time
for i, (r, c) in enumerate(cross_cells):
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c}])
    hud = get_hud()
    grid = get_grid()
    print(f"After click {i+1} ({r},{c}): HUD={hud}")
    print(f"  Grid: {grid}")
    if result.get('game_over') or result.get('level_completed'):
        print(f"  Game state: game_over={result.get('game_over')}, level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
